MAR.note: Only commercial-register extracts are ordered online; no business registration is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Justice's Mahakim portal and Mahakim-Mobile app offer online case tracking, nationality-certificate requests, criminal-record and commercial-register extracts, and property-agency certificate requests.
The Ministry of Justice says its lawyer electronic-exchange platform lets lawyers file pleadings with the chosen court and pay court fees online, the filing going straight to the court.
The Mahakim file-tracking service lets the public follow civil and criminal files, notifications, enforcement and recovery files, and hearing dates by entering the file number at the court.

MAR.note: Document states nothing on police station records.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Justice says lawyers can pay judicial fees electronically through its Mahakim exchange platform, and professionals pay property-agency registration fees online.

MAR.note: Document states nothing on tax filing or payment through a tax authority.
